## Technology Stack

AVENIQ leverages modern, industry-standard technologies to ensure long-term stability and developer portability:

- **Frontend Framework**: React, Next.js (App Router)
- **Programming Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+)
- **Styling & UI**: Tailwind CSS, CSS3 Modules, HTML5 Semantic Markup
- **Backend Runtime & API**: Node.js, Express.js
- **Database Systems**: PostgreSQL, Supabase
- **Asset Management & Storage**: Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare Images
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, Docker on Linux VPS
